firstPlayerRule: Use the game's playful criterion: whoever most recently saw a ghost starts. Play then continues clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starting player begins by dropping both dice into the clock tower.
